title: Who wrote it? The se passive

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *se* with a verb from B1 Unit 6: the verb agrees with the noun that follows. It lets you say what was created or written without naming who did it. New constitutions and courts are a good fit: the institution matters more than the people who made it.

items.spanish: Se escribieron nuevas constituciones en los años ochenta.
items.english: New constitutions were written in the 1980s.

items.spanish: Se creó una Corte Constitucional en Colombia.
items.english: A Constitutional Court was created in Colombia.

items.spanish: Los tribunales se crearon para vigilar las elecciones.
items.english: The tribunals were created to watch over the elections.

sections.content: Singular noun, singular verb (*se creó una corte*); plural noun, plural verb (*se crearon tribunales*). The noun usually follows the verb, but it can come first (*los tribunales se crearon*). To name who acted, use an active sentence or *ser* + participle: *la constitución fue aprobada por el Congreso*.
